title: Function card
responsibility: Shows a linked helper invocation or catalog entity name and a smaller Used In row; model consumers use flat links.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The helper, service or model at the viewed revision, including its recorded name and consumer links.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation that retains branch and commit when opening the helper, service or consumer.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.lens
inputs.description: Revision-scoped screenshot evidence for linked consumers.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: Catalog item using revision-scoped Used In links and previews. Model cards show one flat consumer list; helpers and services retain category groups. Other facts and verification follow the category.
